patterns.note: Content is centered within a maximum width, featuring a two-column grid for article cards that wraps responsively to a single column.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established by pairing a very large, uppercase, condensed display font for main headings and titles with a smaller, more readable sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A deep, dark background color dominates the page, providing a high-contrast canvas for light-colored text and vibrant, warm accent colors used for highlights and interactive elements.
No scroll-triggered motion is observed; the page content scrolls statically from top to bottom without any reveal animations, sticky elements, or parallax effects.

Article cards consistently feature a full-width image at the top, followed by a category tag highlighted with an accent color, a bold title, a short excerpt, and a date, all contained within a dark background.

technique_notes: The site employs a static scrolling model, where all content moves uniformly with the scroll without any reveal animations, sticky elements, or parallax effects.
A dark mode aesthetic is achieved with a deep background color, using light text for readability and a vibrant, warm accent color to draw attention to specific labels and elements.

Content is presented in a card-based layout, where each card features a prominent, full-bleed image at the top, followed by a structured block of text content including a category, title, and description.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, uppercase display headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual impact, contrasted with smaller, regular weight body and meta text for readability.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp; elements like cards and images maintain crisp, rectangular corners throughout the design.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; content is well-spaced within its containers, and grid items maintain clear, consistent gutters, contributing to an organized feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a very dark, almost black-blue background combined with a striking, high-contrast yellow-orange accent color creates a bold and modern aesthetic. This is further amplified by the strong, condensed display typeface, giving the content a powerful and editorial feel.
